exposure: Apgar less than seven in the 1st and 5th minutes of life
outcome: presence of cleft lip and/or cleft palate
cohort: The study included all live births in Brazil, recorded in the Information System on Live Births from 2005 to 2016.
finding: Brazil exhibits an increasing tendency for cleft lip and/or cleft palate, with associations found between its presence and various maternal and newborn factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was found to be associated with the presence of cleft lip and/or cleft palate.
